results.title: EastEnders hunk quits BBC soap after four years – and his exit is set to devastate fans
results.description: EASTENDERS hunk Aaron Thiara has quit the BBC1 soap after four years. The actor, 33, has won over fans with his portrayal of Albert Square bad-boy Ravi Gulati. It comes just a week after the Sun on Sunday revealed that popular actress Kellie Bright, 50, had decided to walk away from Albert Square after 13...
